✨ LAN-Orangutan | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Network discovery and device management for homelab environments.
✨ Key Features: • Auto-discover devices using nmap • Password protected access • Label, group, and add notes to devices • Multi-network support • Tailscale integration
📖 Summary: LAN Orangutan is a self-hosted network discovery tool that allows users to scan their local networks, identify devices, and manage them with persistent labeling. It offers both a web dashboard and a CLI interface, with integrated support for Tailscale.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 univer-workspace | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a collaborative, AI-enhanced office workspace for creating, managing, and reviewing documents and data, suitable for both individual and team use, with options for automation.
✨ Key Features: • Unified office suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides, Bases, Boards) • Real-time co-editing and collaboration
📖 Summary: Univer Workspace is an open-source, self-hostable office suite that integrates documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and databases into a unified environment. It facilitates collaboration between human users and AI agents for content creation, review, and automation, offering multiple entry points like a browser, agent, and CLI.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 nocodb | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a user-friendly, no-code interface for creating and managing databases, with automatic API generation for easy integration into other applications.
✨ Key Features: • Free & Self-hostable Airtable Alternative • Build databases online • Automatic REST API generation • No-code platform • Support for multiple databases (PostgreSQL, SQLite)
📖 Summary: NocoDB is a free, self-hostable alternative to Airtable, enabling users to build databases online with ease. It provides a no-code platform that automatically generates REST APIs, allowing for seamless data management and integration.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 awesome-mac | Swift
🎯 Primary Use Case: Discovering and finding high-quality software for macOS.
✨ Key Features: • Curated list of high-quality macOS software • Systematic organization by category • Facilitates easy search and discovery
📖 Summary: This repository is a curated list of high-quality macOS software, organized by category to facilitate easy discovery and use. It aims to be a comprehensive resource for Mac users looking for reliable applications.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
